name: Dither-TS-TW
title: Dither
description: A full-screen retro dithered background of soft grey clouds and wisps rendered in coarse pixel dots over black, with the whole field slowly flowing and the cursor dimming a spot.
use: You want a textured, retro-computer look behind a hero, with a living grain instead of a flat gradient.
avoid: The coarse pixel dots and heavy grain fight small text, and the effect never holds still.
a11y: The shader and post-processing run continuously and ignore reduced-motion; the canvas has no label. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Black filled with soft grey cloud shapes broken into coarse, speckled pixel dots, as if printed in only a handful of grey levels. The forms are smoky and irregular, dense in some corners and thinning to scattered specks elsewhere.
behaves: The cloud shapes drift and churn slowly across the whole frame, so the grey forms keep changing while the pixel grid stays fixed. Moving the cursor dims a soft area around the pointer.
customise: Props set wave speed, frequency, amplitude and colour, the number of grey levels, pixel size, whether animation is disabled, plus mouse interaction and its radius.
weight: heavy: A React Three Fiber canvas runs a full-screen shader plus a dither post-process every frame.
issues: The coarse dots and grain make small or thin text unreadable over it.
It ignores reduced-motion and never stops or pauses.
polishWhy: Authentic one-bit texture and steady drift, but heavy grain limits what text can sit on it.
